questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Being close to a big city, getting to live abroad

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Very easy. The school officials were easy to get in touch with and provided the needed information.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: The school officials assisted with visa-requirements, how to sign up for courses and all other practical information needed before beginning the semester.

questions.answer: That some of San Francisco's neighborhoods are pretty uncomfortable (like Civic Center/Tenderloin). They should be better informed about where it feels safe to live.

questions.answer: I took the courses: (1) Property, (2) Business Associations, (3) GAI & the Business of Law, and (4) Entertainment Law

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: They followed the curve. The professors expected every student to be prepared and chose students randomly to answer questions in class. Attendance was mandatory.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: I took the courses: (1) Property, (2) Business Associations, (3) GAI & the Business of Law, and (4) Entertainment Law

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: GAI & the Business of Law. This course was highly relevant in light of the current technological development worldwide.
